name: Nexcess
tagline: Managed WordPress, WooCommerce and Magento hosting from Liquid Web
description: Nexcess is a managed hosting provider — owned by Liquid Web — built specifically for WordPress, WooCommerce and Magento sites, with auto-scaling PHP workers, built-in CDN and staging environments rather than a bare-bones shared hosting stack.
about: Nexcess's managed WordPress lineup starts with the Spark plan (1 website, 15GB SSD storage, 2TB bandwidth, 250GB CDN bandwidth) and scales up through higher tiers such as Maker and Designer that add more sites, storage, bandwidth and auto-scaling PHP workers for busier stores and agencies. Every tier — including the entry plan — includes free SSL, a free CDN, unlimited email accounts and mailboxes, unlimited MySQL databases, one-click staging, and automated daily backups with one-click restore. Sites run on Nexcess's own proprietary control panel rather than cPanel or Plesk.

Spark's introductory rate runs $5.25/month for the first three months before renewing at $21/month — a roughly 4x jump once the promo ends, so budget for the renewal price rather than the headline offer. Nexcess doesn't include a free domain with any plan (only a free subdomain to start), and pricing on the higher tiers (Maker, Designer and above) varies by billing term and current promotion, so check Nexcess's own pricing page for the live rate on those plans before committing.
policies: Nexcess backs its hosting plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

faqs.q: Is Nexcess's advertised Spark price what I'll pay long-term?
faqs.a: No. The Spark plan's $5.25/month rate is an introductory price for the first three months; it renews at $21/month afterward. Factor the renewal rate into the real cost before signing up on the lowest headline price.

faqs.q: Does Nexcess include a free domain?
faqs.a: No — Nexcess doesn't bundle a free domain with any plan. You get a free subdomain to launch with, but a custom domain has to be registered or transferred in separately.

faqs.q: Does Nexcess offer a money-back guarantee?
faqs.a: Yes — Nexcess backs its plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee, so you can request a refund if it's not a good fit.

faqs.q: Does Nexcess include a free SSL certificate?
faqs.a: Yes — every Nexcess plan includes a free SSL certificate so your site is secured over HTTPS from day one.

faqs.q: Does Nexcess include a free CDN?
faqs.a: Yes, Nexcess bundles a free CDN with its plans to help speed up page loads for visitors worldwide.

faqs.q: Do I need a promo code to get Nexcess's best price?
faqs.a: Not always — some Nexcess deals apply automatically at checkout, while others require pasting a revealed code into the promo/coupon field before you pay. Check each listing above for details.

faqs.q: How do I get started with Nexcess?
faqs.a: Pick a plan that fits your needs on Nexcess's website, complete checkout, and your account is usually ready within minutes.

faqs.q: Is Nexcess good value for hosting?
faqs.a: Nexcess is one of the more popular hosting providers — compare its plans and any current deal above against your specific needs before committing.

faqs.q: Can I cancel my Nexcess plan anytime?
faqs.a: Most Nexcess plans can be cancelled from your account dashboard; check Nexcess's own terms for any minimum-term or refund conditions that apply to your plan.
